title: Pushing a clean merge of main onto a fix-checked branch is refused
why: The fix-branch deny reads only the push destination, so every lane that merges main after a fix check is refused, although owner ruling R1 (14:07 CST Nov 10, decision pr-review-record) says a clean merge of main keeps the review record. A false alarm against a ruling, likely hit in normal work.
source: coordinator 18:57 CST Nov 12, from lane record-before-fix-push (session_013NEJL419X64MWpu8fiDyB7), #2979
note: Fix: the deny allows a push whose new commits are only a clean merge of main (no conflict, no other change) onto the fix-checked head, and still refuses other pushes. Test red on main first: a clean main merge onto a fix-checked branch is refused today. Home: decision pr-review-record (lines 75-76).
